chunks: Muḥammad ibn Sinān narrated from Ṭalḥah ibn Zayd, who said:
I heard Abū ʿAbdillāh al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام say: “One who acts without insight is like one traveling on other than the path; the speed of his travel only increases his distance from the path.”

key_terms.السَّائِرِ: one who travels or proceeds along a way
key_terms.بُعْدًا: greater distance and remoteness from the right path
key_terms.سُرْعَةُ السَّيْرِ: the speed of moving or proceeding
key_terms.غَيْرِ الطَّرِيقِ: other than the path, meaning away from the correct way
key_terms.غَيْرِ بَصِيرَةٍ: without insight, clear understanding, or discernment

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام say about acting without insight?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that action without insight and sound understanding does not bring a person nearer to truth. Rather, increased effort without guidance can deepen a person’s misguidance and distance from the right path.
